statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The diagnostic monitoring service is medically necessary
The service is consistent with the documented clinical indication (R42)
